container: tsunami-verify service (mem_limit 1g), aarch64 Linux on Mac Docker, Python 3.14, shapely 2.x
method: one process per part; VmRSS after the part is built minus VmRSS after imports (shapely, numpy, hererisk modules). Includes allocator memory retained after parsing (not returned to the OS)
single_process_sequence_note: a sequential single-process run gave smaller deltas for later parts because freed memory was reused; the per-part runs above are the reference
units: MiB (2^20 bytes). Phase 4-M reported the same peaks in MB (10^6 bytes): 205 / 546 / 647 / 818
